name: statspai-empirical-workflow-runtime
description: Portable StatspAI empirical workflow runtime registration package.

interface.shortDescription: Install StatspAI workflow skills and native subagent registry.
interface.longDescription: Packages the StatspAI ten-step empirical-paper workflow skill, native subagent specs, registry schema, and validation scripts so the registration layer can be migrated into another local research project.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $statspai-empirical-workflow to inspect this project's empirical-paper workflow state before planning changes.
